title: Almost Official
html:
Quest Giver: Deidre the Resourceful

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Seek out Deidre the Resourceful in Dew Valley.

Quest Reward: None listed in the client files

Return to: Deidre the Resourceful

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: A Funny Way of Helping

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Seek out Deidre the Resourceful in Dew Valley.

Offer:

I am grateful for your help. If you ever need my assistance, please don't hesitate to seek me out.

As agreed, here is my ticket--help queue ticket #2. Don't go away...I believe you are next to be assisted by the Ministry of Human Resources!

Turn-in:

Greetings! I am Deidre the Resourceful of the Kingdom's Ministry of Human Resources. Do you have ticket #2? Very good. Give it here.

You're almost ready to become an official Dungeon Runner of the realm! Unfortunately, I'm too busy to help you today.

NEXT!

Client level range: 1–5
